CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Bit-packed PcSnapshotPacket's world_object_state (2 bits/fragment instead of a full byte), cutting sizeof(PcSnapshotPacket) from 1408 to 1120 bytes -- a real 288-byte wire-budget win, a narrow first slice of the full-city-conversion wire-budget limit; verified live end-to-end with a real UDP probe using the new pc_wo_state_unpack accessor, confirming correct fragment-state transitions and XP award through the actual packed wire format (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
